decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the auditability requirement, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
The auditability change does not alter the dashboard's purpose or required information; the dashboard-specific clauses are already represented by its same-message Events.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already captures the presentation narrative, while the source Requirement's auditability change does not alter presentation quality or intended use.
Making the overall model easier to audit does not change the selected opex basis, scope, provisional status, or assumption-disclosure rule.
The auditability change does not alter the required Excel format or the prohibition on substituting the PDF version.
Auditability does not change the required conclusion or evidence standard concerning the necessity of availability-style payments.
The source change does not alter the site count, site typologies, authoritative site list, or treatment of missing site-level details.
The auditability requirement does not change the provisional 55/45 financing structure, interest rate, tranche structure, or mezzanine treatment.
The source change does not resolve or modify the model currency, price-base year, or existing CAD-to-AUD ambiguity.
The general auditability requirement does not change the debt-schedule obligation or DSCR coverage output.
The source change does not alter the required Case F and Case G comparison or the availability-payment mechanism assigned to the PPP case.
The auditability change does not alter the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
